title: Mega Man Battle Network 6 - Cybeast Gregar

sources: RetroAchievements code notes of Mega Man Battle Network 6 Cybeast Falzar (no RA entry for this ROM)
notes: Genre: RPG. No RA notes for Gregar: addresses copied from Cybeast Falzar (same engine; the two versions usually share RAM layout). Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: Lan jacks MegaMan.EXE into the Net; battles on a 3x6 grid with chips.
widgets.label: How it plays

widgets.text: A use chip, B buster (hold to charge), L/R select/custom screen.
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: HP up through HP Memory. Folder: 30 chips.
widgets.label: Stats

widgets.text: Chip codes: pick chips with the same code or same name to send more each turn. Program Advances: combine specific chips. Break stage panels for advantage.
